policy: Explicit security/privacy configuration membership; owner decisions recorded in docs/hacktricks-checklist-review.md. Unreviewed checks are untagged.

access_control.rationale: Restrictions on permissions, principals, exposure or access to sensitive services and logging systems.

analyzer.rationale: IAM Access Analyzer existence, health or findings explicitly excluded by the owner.

backup_recovery.rationale: Backup configuration, isolation, recoverability, deletion protection, or protected recovery points.

backup_verification.rationale: Backup freshness and successful restore verification retained by the owner.

dangling_resources.rationale: Checks a dangling resource reference that could leave an abandoned service endpoint.

data_lifecycle.rationale: Explicit deletion/cleanup, bounded session lifetime, or approved credential/runtime lifecycle.

data_protection.rationale: Encryption, key management, credential protection, or prevention of data disclosure.

data_residency.rationale: Enforces approved data/resource locations; retained as a privacy control.

findings_status.rationale: Assessment/finding/compliance status or scan recency rather than a concrete hardening configuration.

generic_baselines.rationale: Arbitrary expected settings or generic drift do not name a security constraint; excluded by the owner.

generic_lifecycle.rationale: Generic policy existence does not establish cleanup/deletion, backup protection or log protection.

governance_metadata.rationale: Labels, inventories, naming or organization structure; excluded by the owner.

governance_process.rationale: Contacts, support, process evidence or inventory/management tooling rather than hardening.

inventory_coverage.rationale: Collection completeness is not a hardening configuration.

log_privacy.rationale: Log settings that suppress sensitive query/error details rather than merely collect telemetry.

log_protection.rationale: Log encryption, retention, immutable storage, validation, or tamper protection retained by the owner.

mixed_security_observability.rationale: Compound predicate includes a hardening requirement; retained by the owner even when it also requires observability.

observability.rationale: Only logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, delivery, notification, or activity detection; no hardening requirement.

operational.rationale: Availability, performance, capacity, service lifecycle or reliability without a concrete security configuration.

presence_only.rationale: Mere presence of a binding, context or service without a permission or exposure constraint.

resource_exhaustion.rationale: Limits, quotas and throttling retained by the owner; CPU/memory requests excluded.

security_configuration.rationale: A concrete preventive security setting, identity constraint, least-privilege rule, supported security runtime, or secret exposure check.

security_tool_enablement.rationale: Security protection/scanning tool enablement retained by the owner; analyzer existence and findings/status are excluded.

unused_assets.rationale: Finds unused, stale, unassociated or empty assets/identities and credentials, as requested.

gcp.review.function.literal_environment_.reason: Literal credentials in runtime and build configuration are a security exposure. This opt-in offline check reports hidden exact-value matches without claiming exhaustive source inspection or credential validity.
